hero.name: Abdulrazzaq A. Liasu
hero.role: Backend Engineer | Cybersecurity Associate | DevOps Enthusiast
hero.summary: Backend Engineer and Cybersecurity Associate with experience in building RESTful APIs, database optimization, and cloud deployments. Certified Sidmach Cybersecurity NextGen Program; passed ISC2 CC exam. Hands-on with authentication, RBAC, system hardening, and database backup/recovery. Skilled in Python, Node.js, Django, NestJS, PostgreSQL, and Docker, with a foundation in DevOps and CI/CD. Experienced in leading teams, mentoring, and technical writing.
